title: Mortal Kombat 11
provenance: Reported by hisis5707-droid (highball#390, 2026-10-19), Apple M1 with 8 GB, macOS 26, Highball 0.7.6: character faces are distorted on both DXVK and DXMT while clothing and stages look normal (screenshot on the issue). Not verified by the maintainer. Brato14 (highball-db#685, 2026-10-25): rated 4 of 5 after 33 minutes, Apple M4, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, msync, vcrun2022, faces creased the same way (asked after the report).
notes: Faces are distorted, clothing and stages fine: the skin shows deep creases on the forehead, the cheeks and under the eyes, as if the game's facial wrinkle detail were turned all the way up. Still so on Highball 0.10.21 with engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28 on an M1 with 8 GB (highball#390, 2026-10-19), on DXMT and, tried the next day, on D3DMetal too. The DXMT log shows the game's tessellation factor clamped from 32 to 8 on GPUs before Apple9, but since D3DMetal, which has no such clamp, draws the faces the same way, that clamp is not the cause. Not diagnosed. A second player rated it 4 of 5 on an M4 with DXMT after 33 minutes, and confirmed the same creased faces there, so they are not tied to the M1 or its memory (highball-db#685).

knownIssues.symptom: Character faces distorted, with deep creases in the skin, clothing and stages fine (DXMT and D3DMetal on an M1 with 8 GB, Highball 0.10.21, highball#390; DXVK on 0.7.6; DXMT on an M4, Highball 0.10.22, highball-db#685)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed. The same on DXMT and D3DMetal, so not either translator's limits (DXMT's tessellation clamp ruled out, 2026-10-20)
